name: TIMECOM
recent: 近期公告主要是雇员公积金局（EPF）和退休基金局（KWAP）的持股变动申报，未见重大企业活动。新闻方面，CIMB Securities 将公司评级上调至「Buy」，并提及股息收益率具吸引力；RAM 维持公司 RM10 亿 sukuk 的 AA1 评级，展望稳定。
notable: CIMB Securities 将 TIME dotCom 评级上调至「Buy」，提及具吸引力的股息收益率。
RAM 维持 TIME dotCom RM10 亿 sukuk 的 AA1 评级，展望稳定。
雇员公积金局（EPF）在 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报持股变动。
risks: 雇员公积金局（EPF）在 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报持股变动，显示大股东持股持续变化。
退休基金局（KWAP）在 10 月多次申报持股变动。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 MYR 477.8 百万，环比增长 5.2%，同比增长 7.2%；净利为 MYR 134.6 百万，环比增长 13.0%，同比增长 28.7%；净利率为 28.2%，高于上一季度的 26.2%。

recent_en: Recent announcements mainly comprise shareholding change filings by EPF and KWAP, with no major corporate activities.
notable_en: RAM affirmed the AA1 rating on TIME dotCom's RM1 billion sukuk with a stable outlook.
EPF filed multiple shareholding change notices between October and November.
risks_en: EPF filed multiple shareholding change notices between October and November, indicating ongoing changes in major shareholder holdings.
KWAP filed multiple shareholding change notices in October.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 477.8 million, up 5.2% QoQ and 7.2% YoY; net income was MYR 134.6 million, up 13.0% QoQ and 28.7% YoY; net margin was 28.2%, higher than 26.2% in the previous quarter.
